Yoga outside.

Make some room in your day.

The plan

A teacher, an outdoor spot and an hour to move. New to yoga? Good. You don’t need to know the poses to join us.

Settle in, follow along and take it at your pace. Stay for the hour or leave when you need to. The teacher and location will be confirmed before we announce a class.

Bring along

Comfortable clothes. Mat and equipment details will be posted with the class.
